author: HillaryClinton
text:
Just this morning, the New York Times reported that China's spy chief wants his government to have more oversight of the AI industry. 

As I said on Friday on @MSNOWNews: the Trump administration has a huge opportunity to enlist China in the effort to rein in AI when President Xi visits in two weeks. They should take it.
